objective: Bind SF-13 independently verified exact release archive and installation lock to SF-06 apply and upgrade, preserving existing conflict detection, deterministic managed outputs and crash recovery, with explicit fail-closed qualification boundaries.
nonGoals: No publisher-signature implementation or claims of authenticated trust provisioning
No silent or automatic installation, deployment, dependency download, release or host capability escalation
No changes to existing target-project authority, CI or manual instruction preservation
decisions: Release trust: externally authenticated digest pin; do not turn a self-written trust file into release authority.
Design must distinguish exact distribution payload-member bytes from deterministically generated target-project routing and ownership state.

obligations.description: Dry-run/apply/upgrade validate exact manifest/bundle/trust/lock schema, expiry, source, digest and compatibility; reject missing, modified or incompatible identity before target writes.
Demonstrate byte-for-byte integrity of every installed distribution-owned member against the authenticated bundle, including post-apply and upgrade tests.
Preserve ownership-conflict prevention, unchanged custom instructions, zero-write dry-run, interrupted write roll-forward and tamper-safe recovery; reject forged or stale lock across recovery.
Windows/Linux parity and meaningful negative fixtures; do not claim publisher signatures, self-attested trust origin or production release.

structure: src/sf/distribution.py: explicit verified archive read and trusted lock identity
src/sf/lifecycle.py: install/upgrade plan, journal and recover preconditions
src/sf/cli.py: explicit installation proof flags and failure behavior
src/sf/integration.py: generated-files/installed-members ownership mapping if required
tests/: identity tamper, byte equality and crash/recovery fixtures
src/sf/pinned.py: qualified pinned lifecycle transaction, archive byte mapping and checked recovery
impact: Installation/upgrade authority boundary and persistent target bytes, but no new release or deployment authority
Input lock/trust may be externally controlled; untrusted source, file paths and stale state must not enable installation effects

budget.network: None at runtime; GitHub connector code review only
budget.execution: Local exact tests and final stable CI once; no build/release on target systems

externalEffects: Implement only on spsoftwarefc/s-f stacked branch; no installation into other repositories
PR #24 must stack on #23 and remain unmerged until cumulative PR #28
Any test-only fixture writes must stay in isolated temporary directories

amendments.reason: Reconciliation found SF-06 generated target routing files cannot demonstrate installed portable archive-member byte equality; isolate a schema-v2 qualified pinned transaction module with explicit exact-byte members, leaving legacy SF-06 previews unqualified and requiring an explicit legacy selection.
